justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/tuple/ImmutablePair.java and src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/tuple/Pair.java. ImmutablePair is a compact value type (197 lines) with one constructor, two final fields, three instance methods (`getLeft`, `getRight`, `setValue`), and a handful of simple factory helpers; its logic is limited to object creation, null-handling, and throwing UnsupportedOperationException for immutability. The broader behavior is centralized in Pair, so ImmutablePair does not show multiple substantial responsibilities or an obvious need to be split into smaller abstractions.
